SQL:
WITH driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        year,
        constructor_id,
        first_round,
        last_round,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driver_id, year ORDER BY first_round) as rn_first,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driver_id, year ORDER BY last_round DESC) as rn_last
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_drives AS (
    SELECT driver_id, year, constructor_id as first_constructor, first_round as first_round_id, last_round as last_round_id
    FROM driver_seasons
    WHERE rn_first = 1
),
last_drives AS (
    SELECT driver_id, year, constructor_id as last_constructor, first_round as first_round_id, last_round as last_round_id
    FROM driver_seasons
    WHERE rn_last = 1
),
driver_race_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT first_round) as distinct_rounds
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY driver_id, year
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    fs.driver_id,
    fs.year,
    fs.first_constructor,
    fs.first_round_id,
    fs.last_round_id,
    drc.distinct_rounds
FROM first_drives fs
JOIN last_drives ld ON fs.driver_id = ld.driver_id AND fs.year = ld.year
JOIN driver_race_counts drc ON fs.driver_id = drc.driver_id AND fs.year = drc.year
WHERE fs.first_constructor = ld.last_constructor
  AND fs.first_round_id < fs.last_round_id
  AND drc.distinct_rounds >= 2
ORDER BY fs.driver_id, fs.year

SQL:
WITH season_info AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        MIN(first_round) as min_round,
        MAX(last_round) as max_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
constructor_at_round AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.year,
        d.driver_id,
        d.first_round,
        d.last_round,
        d.constructor_id
    FROM drives d
    WHERE d.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_last_constructor AS (
    SELECT 
        si.year,
        si.driver_id,
        c1.constructor_id as first_constructor,
        c2.constructor_id as last_constructor,
        si.min_round,
        si.max_round
    FROM season_info si
    JOIN constructor_at_round c1 ON si.year = c1.year AND si.driver_id = c1.driver_id
        AND c1.first_round = si.min_round
    JOIN constructor_at_round c2 ON si.year = c2.year AND si.driver_id = c2.driver_id
        AND c2.last_round = si.max_round
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        first_constructor,
        last_constructor,
        min_round,
        max_round,
        max_round - min_round + 1 as rounds_span
    FROM first_last_constructor
    WHERE first_constructor = last_constructor
      AND rounds_span >= 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id, first_constructor, min_round, max_round, rounds_span
FROM qualified
ORDER BY year, driver_id
